name: Post-Compression Adversarial Audit Registry
purpose: Verify that semantic compression did not accidentally destroy incompleteness, locality, or relation primacy under skeptical scrutiny.

adversarial_tests.finding: Semantic compression did not allow ⇔R to collapse into equality.
Simplification did not introduce infinite-scale assumptions.
Language refinement successfully prevented aspect reification.
Incompleteness remains a primary structural feature.
Compression into families preserved individual failure-class visibility.

governance_rules.rule: Adversarial audits must specifically target 'smoothness' artifacts introduced by compression.
